templates.note: The guide: 'CS did this with 2 groups very easily', 'there is an AoE to beware of'. 200k HP, a 1,500 area of its chain's element every 20 s, a 1,000 crit: ours, below QoV's 700k.

templates.name: talon's veeshan
templates.note: Guide: very little HP, swings 2500s on a 6850 AC Defender, FR AoE 3500 with about a 180 FR debuff, stats too. 300k HP and the crit ours.

templates.name: veeshan's bulwark
templates.note: Guide: extremely high defense, swings 900-1200 on a 6850 AC Defender, CR AoE 2000 with about a 180 CR debuff, stats too; 'a little harder than Norox and QoV'. 1M HP as the PoD bosses, taken 60 for the defense, ours.

templates.name: sky chain boss
templates.note: Granavik: 'with one group he took about 10-15 minutes to kill'. 100k HP, ours.

triggers.name: Construct of Radiance

steps.refuse: The light has taken all it can: sixteen, a pet counting as one.

steps.text: You stand on an isle of the Plane of Sky you have not seen before. Speak with the Astral Light when you are ready. It holds you here thirty minutes.
The light gathers itself, and something answers.
The isle fades. Five minutes and it will send you back.
The Astral Light sends you back.

triggers.notes: The chain's shards at the Astral Light: up to 16 to the isle, 30 minutes, the construct on a talk there, 5 minutes after its death back.

dialog.name: Astral Light
dialog.line: The light hums. It wants a chain's shards, all of them, from one hand.

dialog.name: astral essence
dialog.line: The essence turns slowly. Five lights would wake it, one from each construct.
